response.overview: This film follows Shaolin, a mysterious young man raised within a secluded mountain tribe, far removed from modern society. Curious about the outside world, he leaves his isolated home and journeys into civilisation with a simple goal: to learn from humanity and share the knowledge and wisdom of his own people. Documenting the experience is filmmaker Aiden Diorio, who becomes both observer and guide as he introduces Shaolin to everyday life. Together they travel through a small commuinty, they meet strangers, and engage in conversations that range from profound to absurd. As Shaolin encounters new ideas, technologies, and social customs, he offers his own unique perspective on community, nature, and the meaning of life.
response.tagline: "In the mountains of Shaolin... There lives a man"
response.title: Shaolin 1

results.name: My Life At The Shaolin Temple
